strategy_description: Long XLV when the 6-month-lagged UMCSENT 3-month momentum is above its rolling z-score +1.0 threshold; otherwise cash.
lead_description: Signal lead = 6 month(s) before the rule is applied

selection.rationale: Unique maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the committed coarse monthly grid L{0,1,2,3,4,5,6} (1,339 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.5298). Winner raw OOS Sharpe 1.1586 at L6; the 2nd-best valid combo (S7_dev_ma/T1_fixed_p50/P1_long_cash/L5) sits at 1.118. No ECON-T3 tie-break engaged (unique max on oos_sharpe). Published winner == raw max-OOS-Sharpe valid row -> divergence null.

notes: Ground truth is tournament row 777. Winning threshold uses threshold is rolling (60-month mean plus 1 standard deviation); threshold_value is the latest rolling value - see winner_trade_log.csv for the full threshold path. Signal is lagged by 6 months before the rule is applied.
